An '''herbalist''' was a being who cultivated plants for personal use. [[Telo (Dathomirian)|Telo]] was an herbalist for the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], while [[Bevon Cordh]] was an herbalist from [[Duzay]].
